title: Hiding place discovered
summary: The informer, whose identifier is unclear in the OCR, and the gendarmes found the group hiding in the attic, climbed up by a ladder, and ordered them to come down.
uncertaintyNote: The OCR corruption makes the informer's printed identifier unclear.
